CREATE TABLE "public"."deliveryZone" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "delay" text,
  "fee" numeric NOT NULL,
  "freeAbove" numeric,
  "governorate" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "delivery_zone_delay_f0704b23" CHECK (delay IS NULL OR length(delay) <= 80),
  CONSTRAINT "delivery_zone_fee_fb4159c8" CHECK (fee >= 0 AND fee < 1000),
  CONSTRAINT "delivery_zone_free_above_e057d75c" CHECK ("freeAbove" IS NULL OR ("freeAbove" > 0 AND "freeAbove" < 1000000)),
  CONSTRAINT "delivery_zone_governorate_c0cc3d26" CHECK (length(btrim(governorate)) BETWEEN 1 AND 80)
)
